title: Zephyrine and the Ember
author: Ansel Marchetti
blurb: Rafael Marchetti, a thief who steals memories, has never left the valley where magic cannot follow. But when tonight's date appears in a book of prophecies written a century ago, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. Now they must steal back a soul sold to the court beneath the mountain, and time is already running out.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
